summary: Production Readiness Audit regression test. 29/29 backend/API pytest cases PASS via localhost:3000. All 9 public pages load (200 + full styling), sitemap.xml is dynamic with blog URLs, robots.txt OK, 404 page OK, security headers (X-Frame-Options=SAMEORIGIN, X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff) present, admin login + dashboard work, admin auth guard returns 401 without token, service detail /hizmetler/laboratuvar shows corrected title 'Laboratuvar' (stale title fix confirmed), force-dynamic + no-store cache freshness VERIFIED (admin update to service is immediately visible on public API). Contact + appointment endpoints return 200 (429 after rate-limit threshold — behaving correctly). Admin CRUD (create → update → soft-delete/archive) works for services.

critical.issue: Response leaks MongoDB internal _id field (e.g. '_id':'6a5fbeb388e5305372f9eca4') alongside the app id. Violates DTO discipline (also project code review rule).

minor.issue: Is a soft-delete (archive) — record stays in collection with unique slug reserved. Trying to CREATE later with same slug then UPDATE fails with 500 E11000 (dup key) instead of a 400/409 clean error. Consider returning 409 with clear message, or freeing the slug on archive.
Rate-limit window is very long (~60min per IP). Regression tests hit 429 after a couple of submissions. Acceptable for prod but consider a lower window for repeated identical test IPs / whitelist.

data_issues.issue: Only 10 team members returned but the audit spec expects 13. Also member #1 has full_name='Güncellenmiş Üye İsmi' and bio='Güncellenmiş biyografi' — this is leftover QA/test data that must be reverted to the real name (photo_url is 'team-hasan-murat-turkan.jpeg'). Visible on public /ekibimiz page. Blocks production readiness.

https://9aa6aeb2-90c9-4253-b080-0e346b426a59.preview.emergentagent.com/ returns Emergent's 'Preview Unavailable' 404 (Cloudflare/Webflow) for ALL routes including /api/*. The container app on localhost:3000 is fully healthy — this is an ingress/proxy issue outside the app code. User cannot access the app externally right now.

action_items: Restore team member #1 (Hasan Murat Turkan) real full_name and bio in DB — currently 'Güncellenmiş Üye İsmi'/'Güncellenmiş biyografi'. This is stale QA data still visible publicly.
Investigate missing 3 team members — spec expects 13, DB returns only 10.
Exclude MongoDB '_id' from GET /api/admin/services/[id] response (and audit other admin GET-by-id endpoints for the same leak).
External preview URL routing is broken (serves Emergent 404 page). Restart / re-map the preview so ingress routes to container port 3000 before releasing to user.
Consider hard-delete-on-empty-slug or return 409 (not 500) for slug conflicts against archived services.
